description: Align a Sanger ABIF read to a reference and report identity plus every mismatch, insertion and deletion.

fileBase64.description: The binary ABIF (.ab1 / .abi) trace file, base64-encoded.

minCoverage.description: Fraction of the reference the read must span before a PASS is meaningful; below this the verdict is 'ambiguous_low_coverage' regardless of identity. Lower it when the reference is intentionally just the region/junction being checked.

read.description: Sanger read as FASTA or raw text (alternative to uploading an ABIF trace). Also the per-record field for plate-batch runs via /api/v1/batch.

name: sanger_vs_reference
title: Sanger vs Reference
